At **€600**, a **GeForce RTX 4070** (12GB, non-Super) is **generally a fair-to-good deal**, but context matters—here's a balanced assessment:

✅ **Pros (why it’s reasonable at €600):**  
- The **MSRP at launch was €550–€570** (varies by region), so €600 is only ~5–10% above MSRP — very reasonable, especially considering current market trends (inflation, component costs, taxes, retailer margins).  
- It delivers **excellent 1440p gaming performance**: reliably 60–100+ FPS in modern AAA titles (e.g., *Cyberpunk*, *Starfield*, *Baldur’s Gate 3*) with DLSS 3 and ray tracing enabled.  
- **Power efficient** (~200W TDP) and runs cool/quiet on well-designed models (e.g., ASUS TUF, MSI Ventus, Gigabyte Eagle).  
- Still **future-proof** for 2–3+ years at 1440p; DLSS 3.5 (with Ray Reconstruction) and AV1 encoding are real advantages for creators/streamers.

⚠️ **Caveats (check before buying):**  
- **Is it new or used?**  
  - *New*: €600 is fair — especially if bundled with a discount or retailer promo (e.g., free game, storage).  
  - *Used/refurbished*: €600 is on the *high* side — expect €450–€520 for a clean, warranty-covered used unit.  
- **Model matters**: Avoid ultra-budget models with poor cooling (e.g., some no-name or early “blower” variants). Stick with reputable brands (ASUS, MSI, Gigabyte, EVGA, Zotac, Palit).  
- **Compare to alternatives**:  
  - RTX 4070 **Super** launched at €599–€629 — so if a *4070 Super* is €600, it’s a **better value** (7–10% faster, 12GB GDDR6X).  
  - AMD’s RX 7800 XT (~€550–€580) offers similar raw raster perf and more VRAM (16GB), but lacks DLSS/Frame Gen and has weaker ray tracing & AV1 encoding.

💡 **Verdict**:  
→ **Yes, €600 is a solid price for a *new, reputable-brand RTX 4070*** — especially if you prioritize ray tracing, DLSS 3, efficiency, and Nvidia ecosystem (Studio drivers, Broadcast, etc.).  
→ **No, if a 4070 Super or RX 7800 XT is available at the same price** — then those beat the base 4070.

🔍 *Quick tip*: Check [Geizhals.eu](https://geizhals.eu) or [Idealo.de](https://idealo.de) for real-time price comparisons in your country — and always verify warranty, seller reputation, and return policy.

Let me know your use case (gaming resolution, content creation, etc.) or region — I can help narrow down the best model or alternatives! 🎮✨
